title: eustylis geniculata
intro: Eustylis geniculata, commonly known as Golden Thread or Yin Chen Hao, is a plant species in the family Rutaceae. It has been traditionally used in medicine for its numerous health benefits, including its ability to aid in the treatment of liver and gallbladder issues, improve digestion, and support immune function. The therapeutic actions of Eustylis geniculata are attributed to its ability to stimulate bile secretion and reduce inflammation, making it a useful remedy for conditions such as jaundice and hepatitis. The bioactive constituents of Eustylis geniculata include flavonoids, alkaloids, and volatile oils, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
